rows.statement: Freelancer workbook = FREELANCER_QS_REFERENCE; U-C4N / christiannp = EXTERNAL_ORACLE; neither creates or resolves Urban quantities
oracle values are the owner's recorded figures (S3.1 brief §16); no oracle run or handle list is held in the repository
oracle 'beam downstands' and 'slabs' are taken on the Urban convention (downstand only / full slab depth) as stated in the brief; oracle column height basis is undeclared
Urban concrete = frozen V3b candidate BOQ lines (not FINAL); COMPUTED -> VERIFIED, PARTIAL -> LOWER_BOUND, owner method -> PROVISIONAL; ground slab zones -> LOWER_BOUND
column steel = S3.1 (D2/162, transitions blocked); other categories = V3b net design weights (D2/162)
BEAM_COLUMN_JOINT -> WALLS_AND_COLUMNS (column bars and ties run through the joint); LINTEL not mapped -> ROUGH_RATIO_NOT_CONFIGURED; plain concrete excluded
the owner ratios were calibrated on the freelancer allocation (beam gross depth, slab between beams); on Urban physical volumes BEAMS read low and SLABS high
FRAME_<floor> = columns + joints + beams + slabs is allocation-free; BEAMS or SLABS alone are NOT_COMPARABLE across gross / downstand conventions
freelancer slab area + freelancer beam plan area (width x length) approximates a net plate area
4 m stiffener spacing is URBAN_STANDARD_CANDIDATE - scenario only, never verified
